newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Two fires damage stores in Bahrain, no casualties.
newsitem.headline: Two fires damage stores in Bahrain, no casualties.

text.p: Two timer ignition devices detonated in Bahrain sparking fires that gutted two shops but caused no casualties, a government official said on Wednesday.
The official said the incident took place on Tuesday in a district in Rifaa, 15 km (nine miles) south of the capital Manama. Two other similar devices were discovered before they went off, he added.
"Two devices with timers caused fires in two stores in Bokuwarah. The authorities have also discovered another two devices in the same area," the official told Reuters.
"The incidents were premeditated," he said, but did not elaborate.
A series of arson attacks hit Bahrain, the Gulf's main financial and banking centre, in the past two months in which six Asians died.

More than 30 people have been killed in the Gulf Arab state since anti-government protests, bombings and arson attacks by the island's majority Shi'ite Moslem community erupted in December 1994. Hundreds of people had been detained.
